title: Building lines when the work order is deleted, built twice, or reopened
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Open a work order for a customer and asset (Work Orders > New, pick the customer/unit).
  4. ↳ Start an inspection from a template that has a checkbox field; mark one field Not OK and one Monitor.
  5. ↳ Complete and sign the inspection so it is in its read-only completed view.
  6. ↳ Be able to delete the run-on work order; and have a second user (second browser) who can build from or reopen the inspection concurrently.
custom_steps:
1. Delete the run-on work order, then open the completed inspection; confirm only 'create a new work order' is offered.
2. In a second browser signed in as another user, build from the same inspection while this screen is still open in the first; check the re-build confirmation reflects the current state, not the state when the screen loaded.
3. Reopen the inspection while the screen is open; confirm the action disappears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the run-on work order has been deleted, only the option to create a new work order is offered.
  • If another user builds from the same inspection while this screen is open, the re-build confirmation is based on the current state rather than the state when the screen loaded.
  • If the inspection is reopened while the screen is open, the action disappears.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9101 (S3 — Build from a completed inspection); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S3; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E1: “If the work order the inspection was run on has been deleted, only the option to create a new work order is offered”
  • S3-E2: “If another user builds from the same inspection while this screen is open, the confirmation in S2-R13 is based on the current state rather than the state when the screen loaded”
  • S3-E3: “If the inspection is reopened while the screen is open, the action disappears”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
